shots.focal_element: Headset-wearing players whose real surroundings are replaced by game worlds (living-room dance, rooftop ghost hunt, desert shield fight, arena boxing)
shots.typography: Disclaimer: tiny white sans-serif, sentence case, bottom-centre legal line. Caption: medium-size white geometric sans-serif, semi-bold, sentence case, normal tracking, centred mid-frame with no backing plate (font guess low confidence: Meta's Optimistic-style sans).
shots.what_happens: A fast montage inside one detected shot: a woman dances with a virtual partner on a glowing ring in her living room, then whip-blurred cuts carry her through a night rooftop ghost-hunt with neon energy streams, a dusty desert where she raises a shield against a giant creature, and a motion-blurred push into a stone arena where a boxer throws punches with spark effects while 'When in virtual reality' appears centred from about 24.0 s. Song lyrics (w34-w55) run underneath; 4 code events are reported in this shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut 4-5 full-bleed live-action clips of ~1.5 s each on the 129 BPM beat, bridge each with a 4-6 frame directional motion-blur smear, and fade in a centred white semi-bold sentence-case caption over the final clip.

shots.focal_element: Close-up of the boxer's face wearing the white Quest 3 headset as she raises a finger to double-tap it
shots.typography: White geometric sans-serif, semi-bold, all lowercase, normal tracking, centred over the face with no plate; continues the caption sentence from s012.
shots.what_happens: Tighter shot of the boxer pausing; 'just double tap' appears centred as she lifts her index finger and taps the side of the headset, and a blue glow begins dissolving the virtual arena into a bright real room at the left edge.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold a medium close-up of the subject, fade in a lowercase centred caption on the beat, then start a soft blue-edged luma wipe from one side revealing the real-room plate underneath.

shots.focal_element: A real living room (sofa, round coffee table, framed pier prints) being revealed through the dissolving virtual arena
on_screen_text: to get back to your space
shots.typography: White geometric sans-serif, semi-bold, all lowercase, normal tracking, centred mid-frame; same caption style as s012-s013.

shots.build_rebuild: Composite the virtual-environment plate over the real-room plate and reveal the room with an expanding radial mask whose edge carries a blurred blue glow, keeping the lowercase caption centred throughout.

shots.focal_element: First-person passthrough view of a hand grabbing a teal water bottle, then a man putting on the headset
on_screen_text: to get back to your space

shots.what_happens: The living-room frame pushes/pans right with heavy motion blur (the caption slides away with it) into a first-person view of a hand picking up a teal bottle from a shelf; at about 32.5 s the whole frame shrinks into a tilted rounded-corner card over a pale blue gradient, rotates, and a new card carrying a man adjusting the headset swings in to full frame, where 'Redesigned' animates on centred. By 34.5 s a different man in a tie-dye sweater is on screen with the same word, suggesting an undetected cut near the end.
shots.build_rebuild: Pan the first clip right with a motion-blur push, then scale the frame down to a ~80% rounded-corner card with a soft drop shadow on a light gradient, rotate it ~10 degrees out while the next clip enters as a tilted card that scales back up to full bleed, and reveal the centred title-case word with a per-letter flip.
